proposalPolicy: Draft workflows in docs/ci-proposals are not installed in service repositories. PR CI must use pull_request only, read-only contents permission, no secrets/environments, no deploy-related actions, finite timeout and concurrency cancellation. Required branch checks must be configured separately by a repository administrator.
